MVP.standardization: Within-season candidate-pool z scores, except exponential availability and MVP places-below-fifth inputs, which are uncentered raw terms.
MVP.standings: Conference and league rank by final regular-season win percentage; normalized to 0-1; ties averaged; playoff seed and play-in results excluded
MVP.validation_warning: 2016-2026 results previously inspected; retrospective comparison, not a fresh untouched test.
MVP.selection: User-requested qualified PPG and WS/48 top-five penalties; existing model inputs and settings retained.
MVP.availability: Strictly negative fitted weight times expm1(log(2) * shortfall / (0.10 * team_games)) / (log(2) / (0.10 * team_games)). shortfall=max(0, ceil(0.85*team_games)-G). Zero above threshold; marginal cost doubles each extra 10% season shortfall.
MVP.expectations: Preseason win-total market line scaled to actual team games / planned preseason schedule; actual wins minus scaled expected wins. Coefficient constrained nonnegative. Pre-2003 training seasons are neutral; aggregate-team rows use season-pool median inputs.
MVP.rank_penalties: Exclude players unqualified for either Basketball Reference leaderboard. Add strictly negative fitted slopes times max(0, qualified rank - 5), separately for PPG and WS/48. Raw-place inputs, uncentered and unstandardized. Cached source flags and sorting values are used where available; other seasons use documented qualification rules and local statistics, with rounded WS/48 ties sharing rank.
